data.title: 克莱尔 · 烈日沙滩的强袭扣杀
data.description: 烈日照耀的金色沙滩排球场上。克莱尔凌空跃起，修长结实的腰腹线条与魔剑士的爆发力展露无遗，单臂蓄力重重下劈扣球，黑发在日光中飞舞，眼神充满毫不退让的炽热胜负欲。
data.location: sun-drenched ocean beach volleyball court with net and palm trees
data.action: leaping high in the air above the net, one arm pulled back ready to smash a volleyball with fierce athletic momentum, sharp focused expression
data.lighting: intense blazing summer midday sunlight casting hard dynamic contrast
data.mood: intense athletic power, blazing competitive spirit, stunning combat readiness
data.promptProse: Claire in a sporty red bikini leaps powerfully above a beach volleyball net, arm cocked to spike with intense competitive eyes in bright sun.
data.animaCaption: Claire soaring above the beach net delivering an unstoppable volleyball spike.
